fields.summary_ko.0: Lucid Group (LCID) received an additional $1.75B credit facility from Saudi PIF, bringing total liquidity to approximately $4 billion, enabling operational funding through end of 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 net loss was $831M on revenue of $350M, with cash burn down 30% and gross margin improving to -74%, though PIF-related debt surged from zero at year-beginning to $2 billion.
